## Description

A compound containing two solids, each at distinct `AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D` locations — typically with a non-unit DIRECTION as ref_direction (e.g., (2,0,0) instead of a normalized unit vector), encoding a non-uniform scale via REPRESENTATION_MAP / MAPPED_ITEM — is fed to a shell-merge step. The resulting compound retains the merged shell but loses the location component, displaying every part at the world origin.

## Reproducer recipe

Compound of two cube solids; one at identity, one at a non-unit-DIRECTION `AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D` inside a REPRESENTATION_MAP / MAPPED_ITEM. Process via shell merge.

## Expected kernel behavior

compound-level location chains are preserved through any topology-only operation; merge does not implicitly bake or drop location records.
